title: Power Apps: GitHub-connected models and wider Maker Studio availability for generative pages
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned GitHub connection from the currently documented generative pages experience and the separate canvas authoring agent. Roadmap dates, GitHub credit consumption and the existing tenant-setting path are supported; the remaining feature-specific governance and billing details are appropriately identified as unpublished.
